nom: ANUA PDRN 100 Hyaluronic Acid Glow Pad

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one managing post-menopausal dryness, consistently report deep, long-lasting hydration and plumper, less flaky skin, with a couple also noticing their forehead fine lines look less visible.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin consistently report no irritation, stinging, or redness, describing the pads as gentle and non-stripping even with nightly use, including on skin normally reactive to topical treatments.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including oily-T-zone/dry-cheeks patterns, report the pads balance both zones without clogging pores or leaving a greasy finish; one combination-skin reviewer found the texture too goopy and had trouble with the packaging leaking, though she still noted long-lasting hydration.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one with an oily T-zone and enlarged pores, report the pads balance and smooth the skin without clogging pores or adding shine.
segments.mature: The reviewer who describes her skin as aging (post-menopausal, dry, and patchy) reports the pads made a noticeably positive difference when paired with the matching serum and cream.
segments.normal: The reviewer who describes her skin as normal-to-dry, and usually dehydrated by the end of the day, reports the pads keep it glowy and moisturized all day and night.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines — around the eyes, forehead, and neck — after regular use, often within one to two weeks, with several specifically crediting the added plumping hydration for the smoother look.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry or post-menopausal skin, report deep, long-lasting hydration (some say it lasts a full day) and plumper, softer skin; however, a few reviewers say the serum sat on top of the skin without absorbing or that they saw no meaningful long-term hydration benefit.
concerns.redness: Reviewers dealing with redness or reactive skin, including one whose topical treatments usually left her red and flaky, report calmer, less red skin within days to weeks of regular use.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin report the pads did not trigger breakouts even with regular use over two weeks, and describe them as calming for existing inflammation.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily zones report the pads hydrate without adding shine or clogging pores, balancing drier areas without overwhelming oilier ones.

extraits.texte: This product is not it. I feel like it's basically a medicube wanna-be that fell short. I think it did provide hydration but I don't know if it's the formulation causing the product not to sink in or if there's too much product on the pad, or maybe the pad is too thick and carries too much product? I'm not sure but regardless, the serum did not soak into my skin and just sat on top of my skin even after leaving the pads on my cheeks for 10-15 mins. I do appreciate that there was no scent but this product really just wasn't it. I ended up wiping all the extra serum (which I feel like might've been all of it) off my face after I removed the pads. This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

extraits.titre: Hydrating, but a Bit too Goopy
extraits.texte: As someone who prefers toner pads over liquid toner, I like seeing this concept for what I might consider an essence. It screams hygienic and clean to me. I'm still on fence on how I feel about the formula though, as it's quite different from the other ones I've tried. 🫐 I wanted to love this but something about the texture felt so goopy to me that I almost didn't want to use it. I guess it's supposed to provide more than your standard dose of hydration, but for something that is supposed to gently exfoliate, it kind of felt too thick. 🫐 I use this after cleansing and before applying moisturizer. Usually, right after the toner step, I go straight ahead and apply moisturizer without waiting. For this one though, I felt that I had to wait a little (around 10 minutes) post pad removal to let it fully absorb before I could go onto my moisturizer step. 🫐 The packaging for this leaked everywhere for me once I removed the seal. You need it upright at all times, and if you hold it at an angle for even a second, serum will leak out of the box. I wasn't a fan of this because as I was trying to move it around, liquid was slightly spilling out of the lid. 🫐 Formula wise, while it does take a bit to absorb, it does give a long lasting moisture that lasts for at least a day. I liked how glowy my skin looked and how easy it was to apply makeup the following day. It contains sodium based PDRN, which is great for all skin types, including sensitive ones. I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I tried these Anua Glow Pads along with the PDRN hyaluronic acid serum. I was not a fan of these pads. Firstly, the pads are very saturated. That may sound like a positive, but they're actually kind of over-saturated with the solution it sits in. I found it a but messy and wasteful. A lot like the serum in this product line, these pads left a tacky texture on the skin, which I personally don't like when it comes to skincare. I did not find them to be very hydrating, nor did they do anything for skin texture for me. I like Anua as an overall brand and I'm sure these pads may work for some, but I honestly just wasn't a fan of this product.

This along with the serum and cream has had a huge POSITIVE impact on my dry, aging skin! I've gone through so many skincare brands trying to find the right regimen for my post menopausal, dry, patchy skin, but nothing comes close to hydrating my skin like this! If buying, make sure you pair it with the serum and cream in the same line. I saw a difference after 1 use!

extraits.titre: I would purchase this product again and again!
extraits.texte: The Anua PDRN 100 Hyaluronic Acid Glow Pad has been an amazing addition to my routine. It leaves my skin feeling bouncy and plump - which I especially appreciate in the California heat. Despite the extreme temperatures, the Anua glow pad has ensured that my skin stays deeply hydrated and glowing. Right after utilizing this product I can clearly see the difference in how soft and rejuvenated my skin is. As someone who has sensitive and acne prone skin I can definitely recommend this product as well. It did not break me out even after about two weeks of use. Typically topical medications leave my skin dry and flaky, especially in the summer. After just a few days of utilizing this product I notice that every morning I no longer wake up with scaly sensitive and red skin. It is so convenient in the pad form to just take two and leave them on my face for a few minutes. Tweezers are also provided to prevent contamination between uses which I appreciate. I couldn't recommend this product more, and the glow is evident in the before and after images. * This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review *

extraits.titre: Glowy, not greasy! finally a pad that works for oily-combo s
extraits.texte: I wasn't sure what to expect from these, but the PDRN 100 Hyaluronic Acid Glow Pads have quickly become a new staple in my routine. I have oily-combination skin (oily T-zone, dry cheeks), and most glow products either clog my pores or make me way too shiny by noon. These don't! The pads are generously soaked but not drippy, and the texture feels soft and cushiony and not abrasive at all. I use them after cleansing, and they leave my skin feeling refreshed, hydrated, and just slightly dewy without being sticky. The combo of PDRN (great for skin repair and elasticity) and hyaluronic acid really helps balance out my skin by hydrating the dry areas while not overwhelming the oily spots. I also noticed that my skin looks smoother and more even with continued use, especially around my cheeks where I have texture. Bonus: they don't break me out. If you're oily-combo like me and want a glow that looks natural, not greasy, these are 100% worth trying. Product was received as part of an educational promotion.

I cannot rave about this product enough! It's so good! I have normal to dry skin that drinks up everything I put on it leaving me dehydrated later on in the day. This product however leaves my skin glowy and moisturized all day/night! The pads are super soaked so honestly I only use one compared to people using two for both cheeks. There's enough product on one pad to cover both your face and neck multiple times over. Doesn't leave a sticky residue just hydrated glowy skin that feels super soft and bouncy. I recommend! *Product recieved in exchange for honest review
